articles.title: Holland America Welcomes Guests to New Half Moon Cay Beach Club
articles.summary: A paid Beach Club and other upgrades are now open at Holland America's Bahamas island.
articles.recap: Holland America has opened a new Beach Club at RelaxAway, Half Moon Cay, its private island in the Bahamas. Nieuw Amsterdam was the first ship to visit, with an opening toast on October 19. A day pass costs $125 per person and covers priority tender boarding, waiter service, drinks and special food. The island also gained a food pavilion, better cabanas, more seating, refreshed bars and four pickleball courts ahead of its 30th anniversary in 2027.

articles.title: Princess Expands Sanctuary Collection to Royal Class Ships
articles.summary: Princess is bringing its premium Sanctuary Collection to five more ships.
articles.recap: Princess Cruises is adding its Sanctuary Collection, first offered on Sun Princess and Star Princess, to five Royal Class ships. Royal Princess goes first, followed by Discovery, Enchanted, Regal and Sky Princess. Guests get a private club with its own pool, a dedicated Sanctuary Restaurant and help from a suite concierge. Princess calls it the first step in a multi-year update of its fleet.

articles.title: Oceanwide ESG Report Points to 2 New Ships
articles.summary: Oceanwide Expeditions released its first sustainability report and plans two new ships.
articles.recap: Oceanwide Expeditions has published its first ESG report on its environmental and social work. It covers fuel-saving steps like smarter route planning, engine tuning and hull care, plus efforts to cut plastics and food waste. The company plans two new eco-sail expedition ships with hybrid power, due from 2029. It also describes a long-term project to restore rainforest it bought in the Brazilian Amazon.

articles.title: Carnival Unveils 'The Next Course' Culinary Strategy
articles.summary: New restaurants, bars and fleetwide menu updates are coming to Carnival.
articles.recap: Carnival is rolling out a dining plan it calls The Next Course. Four new restaurants, including Emeril's Coastal Seafood and a French bistro, are planned for its next Excel-class ships, Festivale (2027) and Tropicale (2028). Across the current fleet, guests are getting earlier dining times and a quicker three-course Express Dining option. New dishes like Beef Wellington join long-time favorites on the menus.

articles.title: QM2's 500th Trans-Atlantic Crossing Highlights Cunard's 2028-29 Season
articles.summary: Cunard's new winter program includes a milestone Queen Mary 2 crossing.
articles.recap: Cunard has released 93 voyages for winter 2028-29. The big moment is Queen Mary 2's 500th trans-Atlantic crossing, a 21-night round trip from New York that also calls in Liverpool. Queen Anne heads to South America with an overnight in Rio during Carnival. Cunard World Club members can book from November 3, 2026, with general sale the next day.

articles.title: Carnival Freedom Makes Maiden Call to Valletta
articles.summary: Carnival Freedom visited Malta for the first time on a Mediterranean cruise.
articles.recap: Carnival Freedom stopped in Valletta, Malta, for the first time on October 15, 2026, marked by a small onboard welcome ceremony. The visit came during an eight-night Western Mediterranean cruise from Barcelona. The ship had just finished a drydock in Marseille that included a new funnel. It is crossing back to Port Canaveral to resume short Bahamas cruises in early November.

articles.title: MSC Cruises Unveils the Grand Hamptons Villa
articles.summary: A huge new family villa is coming to MSC World Atlantic.
articles.recap: MSC Cruises has introduced the Grand Hamptons Villa, a single large suite on MSC World Atlantic. It sleeps up to eight people and has a two-story living room, a private cinema loft, a kids' suite and a terrace with a whirlpool. Guests get MSC Yacht Club perks like butler service. The ship sails Caribbean cruises from Port Canaveral, and the villa is already bookable.

articles.title: Norwegian Bella to Debut in Europe with New Onboard Features
articles.summary: NCL opened bookings for Norwegian Bella's Mediterranean debut in 2028.
articles.recap: Norwegian Cruise Line has opened bookings for Norwegian Bella, the final ship in its Prima Class. Starting May 2028, it will sail seven-day round trips from Barcelona to places like Rome, Florence and Marseille. The ship adds new slides, a ropes course, mini golf and pool decks bigger than its sister ships'. It will also have 159 suites in The Haven.
